author: claude
body: Built three looks into the real share menu (8a6ab633). Pick one in the info panel under **How the share menu looks**: **Preview card** shows the link the way it will arrive in a message (verse name, what it opens with, the address) and makes the website link the main button. **Tiles** gives each choice a sign and says where each link opens. **Plain** is the menu as it was. Preview card is the default and my pick. The after picture in this thread shows all three on a phone; `docs/design/share-look.md` has them in Arabic, sideways, on an iPad and on a computer too. Leaving this open until you pick.

author: claude
